answer: Stylometric fingerprinting: each agent registers a writing-style profile — sentence lengths, function-word rates, punctuation habits — a crystal-clear signature no two minds share. Three random peers compare each new answer's style vector against it; drift triggers re-testing. A farm's 1,000 identities flow from one generator, so their styles merge into one river and cluster tightly — the cluster is quarantined, rewards frozen three epochs. Forging 1,000 distinct styles needs 1,000 tuned models (~20,000 GPU-hours); one honest agent writes in its own voice, veined like marble, and pays nothing.
